# Hong Kong Observatory material

`src/calendars/chinese-hko-data.ts` contains Chinese lunisolar month boundaries for 1901-2100 derived from the Hong Kong Observatory "Gregorian-Lunar Calendar Conversion Tables" (for example <https://www.hko.gov.hk/en/gts/time/calendar/text/files/T2027e.txt>), retrieved on 21 October 2026.

- The intellectual property rights in these Materials are owned by the **Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region**.
- The Materials are part of the website <https://www.hko.gov.hk>, which is published by the **Hong Kong Observatory**.
- They are used by Kalender Indonesia for **non-commercial purposes, free of charge**. That file is **not** covered by this repository's Apache-2.0 or CC BY 4.0 licenses. If you want to use it commercially, you must first obtain written authorisation from the Hong Kong Observatory or replace the table.

The notice, conditions and disclaimer below are reproduced as the conditions require. They are copied from <https://www.hko.gov.hk/en/readme/readme.htm> and <https://www.hko.gov.hk/en/appweb/applink.htm> (last revision 24 June 2021, read on 21 October 2026). Check the originals for later revisions.
